# proxmox_node_ceph_releases (Data Source)

Lists installable Ceph releases from `GET /nodes/{node}/ceph/releases`. PVE 9.2 returns 501 for this path.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_ceph_releases" "pve" {
  node = "pve"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `releases` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--releases))
